scope: A-D; portfolio E requires successful A-D and baseline parity
C_KR_definition: Pooled KR constituents, each excess measured against its own KOSPI or KOSDAQ benchmark; equal stock weighting. Local factor median of stock excess. Market controls equal eligible-constituent weighted local benchmark.
C_execution: decision before target next market open; source and local features available strictly before open; daily previous-eligible equal-weight basket, first day open-to-close then close-to-close
D_candidates: all frozen-rule candidate signals before cash/slot/holdings restrictions; KOSPI confirmed and KOSDAQ/A0 onset
D_execution: next target market open only with positive source volume; unavailable open marked unexecutable, never silently deferred
D_exit: horizon market-session close; missing endpoint censored, not zero; proxy liquidation requires separate labeled diagnostic
evaluation: 2018-2021 discovery; 2022-2024 reused historical validation; 2025 and 2026 separate diagnostics; maximum60session boundary purge
